# Flutter Maven Plugin

> A Maven plugin that automates Flutter SDK installation and command execution within Maven projects, requiring no global Flutter installation.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+
- Single-module Maven plugin (`maven-plugin` packaging)
- Two Flutter install methods: binary archive download (version-specific) or Git clone (channel-based: stable/beta/dev)
- Multi-platform support: Windows, macOS, Linux with automatic OS/architecture detection
- Inherits Maven proxy configuration and repository credentials for corporate environments
- Major dependencies: Eclipse JGit, Apache Commons Compress/Exec, Apache HttpClient, Semver4j
- License: Apache License 2.0
